versions.changelog: - Add checksum verification to install script

- The installation script has been moved to scripts/install.sh for improved project organization.
- Updated installation instructions to use the new script location.
- Added metadata (author, source, homepage) to the skill description.
- Clarified the recommended usage of Lightpanda as an alternative when the built-in Web Search tool is unavailable.

- Added instructions recommending Lightpanda with DuckDuckGo as a programmatic alternative to the Web Search tool when web search is needed.
- Clarified that this approach is useful when Web Search is unavailable or when more control over search result navigation and extraction is required.
- No other changes to features or installation.

- Initial release of the Lightpanda browser skill.
- Provides a headless, lightweight browser optimized for fast data extraction and automation without graphical rendering.
- Exposes a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) endpoint, compatible with Playwright and Puppeteer clients.
- Supports Linux and macOS (Windows not supported).
- Limited to one CDP connection, context, and page per process; use multiple processes for parallel tasks.
- Includes installation instructions, usage examples, and troubleshooting guidance.
